historical_record.description: The Recreation and Park Commission approved the Dolphin Club's request to rebuild its women's and men's locker rooms, with disabled access.

The Board of Park Commissioners had the Department of Public Works award Walter Lenkeit, the low bidder at $4,970, the contract for the new exterior of the rowing clubs' buildings at Aquatic Park, to the City Architect's design.
